about.heroText: Considered design. Honest materials. Built to be worn hard.
about.introBody: At Iron Ascension, we curate elite-level performance solutions and high-tier athletic gear designed for serious bodybuilders, athletes, and fitness professionals. Built on a foundation of strict laboratory standards and a premium pharmaceutical aesthetic, our platform serves as a complete destination for both advanced compound protocols and official brand merchandise.
about.catalogText: We maintain distinct divisions, plus a dedicated merch line.
about.merchText: A dedicated line of premium athletic apparel and training gear.
about.processText: To keep every order accurate and discreet, {brand} uses an Order-Request Cart Workflow rather than direct online payment processing.

processSteps.title: Select & Reserve
processSteps.text: Browse the catalog or merch section, choose your items, and submit an order request through the reservation cart.

processSteps.title: Stock Verification
processSteps.text: Our team reviews your request, verifies stock availability for your items, and reserves your allocation.

processSteps.title: Fulfillment Confirmation
processSteps.text: You receive direct, secure confirmation details with your order breakdown and simple payment steps to start dispatch.

about.qualityBody: Every compound listed on Iron Ascension is subject to high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) quantitative testing and purity verification. Whether you are ordering cycle support or official Iron Ascension gear, we prioritize total transparency and premium execution.

faqItems.a: We use an order-request cart instead of instant payment. Choose your items, send your request, and our team confirms availability and sends payment and dispatch instructions.

faqItems.q: Is my card charged when I submit a request?
faqItems.a: No. A request is only a pending reservation. You can change or cancel it before you receive payment and dispatch confirmation.
Unworn, unwashed items in original packaging with tags can be exchanged or returned for store credit within 30 days of delivery. See the Shipping & Returns page.
Requests are usually reviewed within 24 business hours (Monday to Friday). Once your parcel ships, you receive tracking details by email where available.
Yes. You must be 18 or older, or the age of majority where you live, to submit an order request.

faqItems.q: How do I get a discount?
faqItems.a: Mix & Match discounts apply automatically as your cart grows. Spend $100 or more and get a free cap. New customers can use a welcome code, and paying with Bitcoin gives an extra discount. They stack up to a combined cap.

faqItems.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqItems.a: Bitcoin, Cashapp, Apple Pay, Zelle, Chime and PayPal. Pick your preferred method in the cart and we confirm it with you directly.

about.ctaText: Our customer support team is available to assist with order requests or availability.

categories.name: INJECTABLES
categories.seoDescription: Shop research-grade injectables including testosterone, trenbolone, masteron and primobolan formulations with clear strengths and prices.
categories.intro:
The Iron Ascension injectables catalog brings together testosterone, nandrolone, trenbolone, masteron, primobolan and blend formulations in one place. Every listing shows the compound name, concentration and current catalog price, so you can compare short esters, long esters and high-concentration options without guessing.

We focus on clear product labeling, consistent batch presentation and discreet packing on every order request. Whether you are building a foundational testosterone protocol or restocking a specific compound, this collection covers the most requested injectable formats. Our team confirms availability before payment and dispatch instructions are sent.

faq.q: How are injectable products shipped?
faq.a: Order requests are reviewed within 24 business hours, then packed discreetly. Tracking details are sent by email after your parcel is handed to the carrier.

faq.q: Can I mix products from different categories in one request?
faq.a: Yes. Build your cart across injectables, orals, PCT, HGH and support products, then send a single order request.

faq.q: Are the listed concentrations accurate?
faq.a: Each product name includes its concentration, such as 250 or 300. Our team verifies the item and batch before confirming your request.

faq.q: How do I ask about stock?
faq.a: Use live chat or the contact page with the product name. Support can confirm current availability before you submit your request.

categories.name: Oral Tablets
categories.seoDescription: Compare oral tablets including Anavar, Turinabol, Dianabol, Anadrol, Winstrol and Proviron with clear strengths, sealed packs and simple ordering.
categories.intro:
Our oral tablet range covers Anavar, Turinabol, Dianabol, Anadrol, Winstrol, Halotestin and Proviron across multiple strengths. Tablets are presented in clearly labeled, sealed packs, and every listing shows the compound, dose per tablet and catalog price.

This makes it straightforward to compare short-acting oral options for a cycle or to restock a specific dose. We keep the ordering process simple: add what you need to the cart, send one order request, and our team confirms stock before sending payment details. If you are unsure which strength matches your plan, support can point you to the right listing.

faq.q: What strengths are available?
faq.a: Current listings range from Anavar 5 and 10 up to Anavar 50, with Turinabol 10, Dianabol 25, Anadrol 25, Winstrol 25, Halotestin 10 and Proviron 25.

faq.q: Are tablets sold in sealed packs?
faq.a: Yes. Oral products are supplied in sealed, labeled packaging. Our team checks the pack before dispatch.

faq.q: Can I request a mix of oral products?
faq.a: Yes. Add each item to your cart and send one order request. Mix-and-match discounts apply automatically as your cart grows.

faq.q: How do I know a tablet is in stock?
faq.a: Submit your request and our team verifies availability. You can also ask support about a specific item before ordering.

categories.name: PCT
categories.seoDescription: Shop PCT products including Clomid 50 and Nolvadex 25. Compare strengths, check availability and add post-cycle support to your order request.
categories.intro:
The PCT category covers Clomid 50 and Nolvadex 25, two of the most requested post-cycle therapy products. These listings are grouped separately so they are easy to find alongside the main catalog.

Each product page includes the compound, strength and price, and you can combine PCT items with other categories in a single order request. Our support team can confirm stock, explain the order-request workflow and help you check that your cart is complete before you send it.

faq.q: What is included in the PCT category?
faq.a: PCT currently includes Clomid 50 and Nolvadex 25. Additional support items are listed in the Performance & Support category.

faq.q: Can PCT products be combined with a cycle order?
faq.a: Yes. Add PCT items to the same cart as your other products and send one request.

faq.q: Do you provide dosing advice?
faq.a: We provide product and ordering information only. For medical guidance, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

faq.q: How quickly are PCT requests reviewed?
faq.a: Requests are usually reviewed within 24 business hours, Monday to Friday.

categories.name: HCG
categories.seoDescription: Shop Gonasi 5000 IU HCG with clear product details, discreet packing and a simple order-request process. Check availability with our team.
categories.intro:

Each listing states the product format and price, and our team confirms availability before payment and dispatch. If you need help checking what is currently in stock, contact support with the product name and quantity you are considering.

faq.q: What HCG product is available?
faq.a: The current listing is Gonasi 5000 IU. The product page shows the current price and format.

faq.q: How should HCG be stored?
faq.a: Follow the storage instructions supplied with the product. If you have questions about a specific kit, contact support before ordering.

faq.q: Can I add HCG to an existing request?
faq.a: Yes. Add it to your cart before sending the request, or contact support if you need to change a pending request.

faq.q: Is HCG shipped discreetly?
faq.a: Yes. Orders are packed discreetly and tracking is sent by email where available.

categories.name: PEFORMANCE & SUPPORT
categories.seoDescription: Shop performance and support products including aromatase inhibitors, SARMs, Clenbuterol, T3 and research compounds in one organized category.
categories.intro:
This category brings together ancillary and support products: aromatase inhibitors such as Arimidex, Aromasin and Letrozole, cycle-support items, and a broad selection of SARMs and research compounds including MK-677, SR-9009, GW-501516 and GW-0742. It also includes Testogel, Viagra, Cialis, Clenbuterol, Cytomel T3, Lipo X and 5-Amino-1MQ.

Every listing shows the product name, strength and price so you can compare options quickly. Combine any of these items with your main order and send a single request; our team will verify stock before dispatch.

faq.q: What kinds of products are in this category?
faq.a: Aromatase inhibitors, cycle support, SARMs, research compounds and selected performance products.

faq.q: Can I combine support products with injectables or orals?
faq.a: Yes. The cart accepts products from every category, and one request covers the whole order.

faq.q: Are SARMs listed here or in the SARMs category?
faq.a: Both. The SARMs category groups the core SARM listings, while this category includes additional research compounds and support items.

faq.q: How do I check availability?
faq.a: Send an order request or contact support with the exact product name and quantity.

categories.name: HGH

faq.q: Which HGH kits are listed?
faq.a: Humatrope 100 IU, Dynatrope 100 IU, Genotrophin 36 IU, Somatotropin Kit 100 IU, Hygetropin 200 IU Kit and HGH Kit 100 IU.

faq.q: How are HGH kits shipped?
faq.a: Kits are packed carefully and shipped discreetly. Tracking is emailed where available after dispatch.

faq.q: Are the kits complete?
faq.a: Each listing describes the kit size and format. Contact support if you need to confirm what is included in a specific kit.

faq.q: Can I order more than one kit?
faq.a: Yes. Set the quantity on the product page or add multiple kits to your cart before sending the request.

categories.name: SARMS
categories.seoDescription: Shop SARMs including Ostarine, Ligandrol, Testolone, Andarine, S23, YK-11 and RAD-150 with clear strengths and simple order requests.
categories.intro:
Our SARMs section covers Ostarine (MK-2866), Ligandrol (LGD-4033), Testolone (RAD-140), Andarine (S4), S23, YK-11, RAD-150 and LGD-3033. Each listing includes the compound name, strength and price, making it easy to compare selective receptor modulators in one place.

faq.q: Which SARMs are available?
faq.a: Ostarine, Ligandrol, Testolone, Andarine, S23, YK-11, RAD-150 and LGD-3033 are listed in this category.

faq.q: What do the numbers in product names mean?
faq.a: The number usually shows the strength or concentration of the compound, for example 10. Check the product description for details.

faq.q: Can I combine several SARMs in one order?
